joystick.name: Joystick gait from the programmatic teacher
joystick.goal: Start from the simple programmatic gait (the scripted tripod teacher and its BC clones) and use RL to make it genuinely joystick controllable. DONE when one policy (or the session controller stack) follows a randomized 60-second joystick command script in MuJoCo with ZERO falls, directions actually followed, and little slip (slip/m no worse than the scripted teacher's measured band, <=~2.9 at the measured plant), across a held-out eval panel (n>=12 episodes, det+sto, DR-0 and own-DR).

amp.name: AMP locomotion from scratch
amp.goal: Implement the AMP program in rl_docs/AMP_LOCOMOTION.md: adversarial motion priors + massively parallel PPO + privileged critic + observation history + actuator/fault randomization, trained from scratch on the existing MJX GPU stack (no Isaac Lab). The demonstration gait is training data, not the controller. Build every tool it needs (motion library, discriminator, GRU actor, joystick command env, eval suite) and do not pause on operator input. DONE when milestone M5 (MuJoCo cross-engine transfer of the M2-M4 policy) passes per the brief; M6 hardware deployment is operator-owned.

walkcurr.name: Prior-free walking curriculum (Kawawa-2022 lineage)
walkcurr.goal: From-scratch/prior-free PPO walking curriculum (operator registration 20260823T154657Z, built on the cw-kawawa2022-pf-flat1 FAIL lesson): no gait clock, no BC teacher, no motion prior. Rung ladder: walk-only fixed forward command (0.05-0.06 m/s, no heading changes) first; only after a pass, small heading set -> full fixed headings -> irregular direction changes -> DR/push hardening; speed obedience secondary. Every reward-mechanism rung requires the WALKCURR_PF semantics bank green (clean commanded walking > park/stall > sideways/reverse/wrong-way > high-slip/skate/fall under the same command) BEFORE launch. BINDING TRIAGE RULE: log reward trend AND walk-eval trend together; reward rising while walk eval is flat/down or walk terminates = misaligned -> stop same-recipe seeds/continuations and audit reward/eval/simulator. DONE when a prior-free policy passes a held-out C-env contextual walking panel (fixed + changing directions) with zero falls, direction actually followed, low slip/m, all-six-leg gait validity, on video.

cpg.name: Berkeley-style CPG gait search
cpg.goal: Treat the Yang/Levine microrobot result as its own locomotion path: optimize a low-dimensional SE2FootGait/CPG controller with direct MuJoCo behavioral scoring instead of PPO reward learning. DONE when the best parameterized controller passes a held-out contextual gait gate with zero falls, low loaded-foot slip, correct headings, turns, stops/restarts, and enough robustness to become either a deployable deterministic controller or a pre-registered teacher/motion-library source. Downstream adoption into joystick or AMP must be measured as an A/B fork, not a silent teacher swap.

standwalk.name: Mesh-era stance retrain, then teacher distillation into walking
standwalk.goal: Operator registration 08-24 evening. Stage 1: retrain the best rising-and-lowering (stance) capability on the NEW mesh model family at 100 Hz. The legacy stance champion ppo_goal_cw_stance_dr10 is a primitive-family 25 Hz policy and CANNOT be resumed or warm-started (families do not transfer) - rerun/adapt its recipe with env.model_source=mesh + control.hz=100. Stage-1 gate: rise/hold/lower panel on mesh, n>=12, det+sto, DR-0 + own-DR, zero falls/tips, quiet hold, rise/lower tracking comparable to the legacy champion's band (re-measured on mesh). Stage 2: use the stage-1 policy as a TEACHER and distill rise/lower plus the best walking behavior (joystick champion lineage stotight45-seed13, or its mesh-era successor via pre-registered adoption) into ONE mesh-family 100 Hz policy. DONE when that single policy, starting from sit, rises, follows a randomized 60-second joystick command script with ZERO falls, directions followed, and slip/m within the joystick band (<=~2.9), then lowers back to sit - held-out panel, n>=12, det+sto, DR-0 and own-DR.
